What this part coversApa yang bahagian ini liputi

Parts 1 and 2 ended with the nodal displacements. This part turns them into what a design needs — strains, stresses, principal and von Mises stresses at any point — and asks how far each can be trusted: centroid values against beam theory, the jumps between elements, the fixed corner that never converges, and the 8-node element that bends without locking. It closes with the four things every FE results section needs and the brief of the group project.Part 1 dan 2 berakhir dengan nodal displacement. Bahagian ini menukarkannya kepada apa yang diperlukan dalam reka bentuk — strain, stress, principal stress dan von Mises stress pada mana-mana titik — dan bertanya sejauh mana setiap satu boleh dipercayai: nilai centroid berbanding beam theory, lompatan antara element, bucu tetap yang tidak pernah converge, dan 8-node element yang melentur tanpa locking. Ia ditutup dengan empat perkara yang wajib ada dalam setiap bahagian keputusan FE dan taklimat projek kumpulan.

After this part you should be able toSelepas bahagian ini, anda sepatutnya boleh

  1. Recover strains and stresses at a point of an element from its nodal displacements, {ε} = [B]{û} and {σ} = [E][B]{û}, and compute the principal and von Mises stresses.Mendapatkan semula strain dan stress pada satu titik dalam element daripada nodal displacement-nya, {ε} = [B]{û} dan {σ} = [E][B]{û}, dan mengira principal stress serta von Mises stress.
  2. Explain where computed stresses are accurate (element centroids, away from supports and loads) and where they are not (element edges, re-entrant corners, point loads).Menerangkan di mana stress yang dikira tepat (centroid element, jauh dari support dan load) dan di mana tidak (tepi element, re-entrant corner, point load).
  3. Describe the 8-node element, convert an edge load into its 1/6 – 2/3 – 1/6 nodal loads, and explain why it needs far fewer elements than the 4-node element in bending.Menerangkan 8-node element, menukar edge load kepada nodal load 1/6 – 2/3 – 1/6, dan menerangkan mengapa ia memerlukan jauh lebih sedikit element berbanding 4-node element dalam bending.
  4. Report an FE study to the project standard: idealisation, a convergence table with an error estimate, one independent check, and quantified conclusions.Melaporkan kajian FE mengikut piawai projek: idealisation, convergence table dengan anggaran ralat, satu semakan bebas, dan kesimpulan yang dikuantifikasi.

Recall 1Ingat semula 1

For a four-node plane-stress element, the size of [B] isBagi four-node plane-stress element, saiz [B] ialah

Three strains (εxx, εyy, εxy) from eight nodal displacements: [B] = [∂]ᵀ[N] is 3 × 8. [N] is 2 × 8 and [k] = t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA is 8 × 8. Today [B] turns the solved displacements into strains.Tiga strain (εxx, εyy, εxy) daripada lapan nodal displacement: [B] = [∂]ᵀ[N] bersaiz 3 × 8. Recall 2Ingat semula 2

The 2 × 2 Q4 mesh gives a tip deflection of 0.131 m against 0.192 m from beam theory. The coarse mesh isMesh Q4 2 × 2 memberi tip deflection 0.131 m berbanding 0.192 m daripada beam theory. Mesh kasar itu

0.131/0.192 = 0.68: the bilinear elements cannot bend without a spurious shear strain, which resists the bending (shear locking). Refining, or using 8-node elements, removes most of it. Today: what that means for the stresses.0.131/0.192 = 0.68: element bilinear tidak dapat melentur tanpa shear strain palsu, yang menentang bending (shear locking). Refine, atau menggunakan 8-node element, menghapuskan sebahagian besarnya. Hari ini: apa maksudnya untuk stress.

1. Stresses from the nodal displacementsStress daripada nodal displacement

≈ 10 min

Plane Stress Part 2 ended with the nodal displacements of the cantilever. They are the primary result: the method solved for them. Everything a designer reads afterwards — strains, stresses, principal stresses, von Mises — is derived from them by differentiating the interpolation inside each element. The tool for that is the matrix [B] that already built [k].Plane Stress Part 2 berakhir dengan nodal displacement bagi cantilever. Itulah primary result: kaedah ini menyelesaikan nilai itu. Segala yang dibaca oleh pereka selepas itu — strain, stress, principal stress, von Mises — diterbitkan daripadanya dengan membezakan interpolation di dalam setiap element. Alat untuknya ialah matrix [B] yang sudah membina [k].

Three stepsTiga langkah

  1. Locate. Find the element that contains the point, take its local coordinates x, y from its local node 1 (the rule from Heat Transfer Part 2), and list its eight nodal displacements in local order, u before v at each node.Cari. Kenal pasti element yang mengandungi titik itu, ambil koordinat local x, y dari node local 1-nya (peraturan dari Heat Transfer Part 2), dan senaraikan lapan nodal displacement-nya mengikut susunan local, u sebelum v pada setiap node.
  2. Strains. Evaluate [B] (3 × 8) at the point and multiply by {û} (8 × 1).Strain. Nilai [B] (3 × 8) pada titik itu dan darab dengan {û} (8 × 1).
  3. Stresses. Multiply by [E] (3 × 3). Then, if the design needs them, the principal and von Mises stresses (§2).Stress. Darab dengan [E] (3 × 3). Kemudian, jika reka bentuk memerlukannya, principal stress dan von Mises stress (§2).

Column by column, [B] holds the derivatives of the four shape functions of Heat Transfer Part 1, each used twice: once for u and once for v. Written out, its three rows are the three strains:Lajur demi lajur, [B] memuatkan derivative empat shape function dari Heat Transfer Part 1, setiap satu digunakan dua kali: sekali untuk u dan sekali untuk v. Apabila ditulis penuh, tiga barisnya ialah tiga strain:

The usual trapPerangkap biasaGlobal coordinates in [B]. The point (3.5, 1.3) of the cantilever lies in element 4, whose node 1 is at (2, 1): [B] is evaluated at x = 1.5, y = 0.3. With the global values the shape-function derivatives are wrong, and nothing in the arithmetic warns you.Koordinat global dalam [B]. Titik (3.5, 1.3) pada cantilever terletak dalam element 4, yang node 1-nya di (2, 1): [B] dinilai pada x = 1.5, y = 0.3. Dengan nilai global, derivative shape function menjadi salah, dan tiada apa dalam aritmetik yang memberi amaran.

2. Principal and von Mises stressesPrincipal stress dan von Mises stress

≈ 6 min

Three stress components describe the state at a point, but a design check needs one or two numbers that do not depend on the x and y axes you happened to choose. Rotating the axes until the shear vanishes gives the principal stresses; combining the components into an equivalent uniaxial stress gives von Mises.Tiga komponen stress menerangkan keadaan pada satu titik, tetapi semakan reka bentuk memerlukan satu atau dua nombor yang tidak bergantung pada paksi x dan y yang kebetulan dipilih. Memutar paksi sehingga shear hilang memberi principal stress; menggabungkan komponen menjadi satu stress uniaxial yang setara memberi von Mises.

Principal stresses and their directionPrincipal stress dan arahnya

θp is measured from the x-axis to the direction of σ1; −30° means 30° clockwise. On Mohr’s circle the centre is at (σxx + σyy)/2 = 135.1 and the radius is 359.3 kN m−2; the Stress Recovery Explorer draws it for every probe.θp diukur dari paksi x ke arah σ1; −30° bermaksud 30° ikut arah jam. Pada Mohr’s circle, pusatnya di (σxx + σyy)/2 = 135.1 dan jejarinya 359.3 kN m−2; Stress Recovery Explorer melukisnya untuk setiap probe.

Von MisesVon Mises

In plane stress the third principal stress, σzz, is zero, which is why von Mises can be written with σ1 and σ2 alone. In plane strain σzz = ν(σxx + σyy) and the formula changes.Dalam plane stress, principal stress ketiga, σzz, ialah sifar, sebab itulah von Mises boleh ditulis dengan σ1 dan σ2 sahaja. Dalam plane strain σzz = ν(σxx + σyy) dan formulanya berubah.

  • Concrete cracks in tension: σ1 and its direction decide where cracks open and how the reinforcement should run in a wall or a deep beam.Konkrit retak dalam tension: σ1 dan arahnya menentukan di mana retak terbuka dan bagaimana tetulang patut disusun dalam dinding atau deep beam.
  • Steel yields when σvM reaches fy. ANSYS plots von Mises by default; know what it is before you read the colours.Keluli alah apabila σvM mencapai fy. ANSYS memplot von Mises secara default; fahami maksudnya sebelum membaca warna.
Invariant checkSemakan invariantσ1 + σ2 = σxx + σyy for any rotation: 494.4 − 224.1 = 270.3 = 315.2 − 44.9. A slip in the square root fails this check at once.σ1 + σ2 = σxx + σyy bagi sebarang putaran: 494.4 − 224.1 = 270.3 = 315.2 − 44.9. Kesilapan dalam punca kuasa dua akan gagal semakan ini serta-merta.
Key pointsPerkara utama
  • σ1,2 = centre ± radius of Mohr’s circle; θp = ½ tan−1[2σxy/(σxx − σyy)].σ1,2 = pusat ± jejari Mohr’s circle; θp = ½ tan−1[2σxy/(σxx − σyy)].
  • Cantilever at (3.5, 1.3): σ1 = 494.4, σ2 = −224.1 at −30.0°; σvM = 636.8 kN m−2.Cantilever pada (3.5, 1.3): σ1 = 494.4, σ2 = −224.1 pada −30.0°; σvM = 636.8 kN m−2.
  • Concrete: σ1 and its direction. Steel: σvM against fy.Konkrit: σ1 dan arahnya. Keluli: σvM berbanding fy.
Quick check · not gradedSemak cepat · tidak bergred

A point carries pure shear: σxx = σyy = 0, σxy = 100 kN m−2. Its principal stresses areSatu titik mengalami pure shear: σxx = σyy = 0, σxy = 100 kN m−2. Principal stress-nya ialah

The centre of Mohr’s circle is 0 and its radius is √(0 + 100²) = 100, so σ1,2 = ±100; tan 2θp is infinite, so θp = 45°. Von Mises is √3 × 100 = 173 kN m−2.Pusat Mohr’s circle ialah 0 dan jejarinya √(0 + 100²) = 100, jadi σ1,2 = ±100; tan 2θp infiniti, jadi θp = 45°. Von Mises ialah √3 × 100 = 173 kN m−2.

3. How far can a computed stress be trusted?Sejauh mana stress yang dikira boleh dipercayai?

≈ 9 min

The method solves for displacements; stresses come one differentiation later. A bilinear displacement field has strains that are only linear at best, and each element computes them from its own nodes, so stresses are one order less accurate than displacements and they jump from one element to the next. On the 2 × 2 cantilever the tip deflection is 32% low; some of the stresses are worse.Kaedah ini menyelesaikan displacement; stress datang selepas satu pembezaan. Displacement field bilinear mempunyai strain yang paling baik pun hanya linear, dan setiap element mengiranya daripada node sendiri, jadi stress kurang tepat satu peringkat berbanding displacement dan ia melompat dari satu element ke element seterusnya. Pada cantilever 2 × 2, tip deflection rendah 32%; sesetengah stress lebih teruk.

  • The mesh error (first column against the second): up to 30% at the centroids of the 2 × 2 mesh, and two different values, 857 and 185, at one point on a shared side.Ralat mesh (lajur pertama berbanding kedua): sehingga 30% pada centroid mesh 2 × 2, dan dua nilai berbeza, 857 dan 185, pada satu titik di sisi yang dikongsi.
  • The error of the check itself (second column against the third): 0.03% at mid-span but 32% at x = 3.5 m. Near the loaded end the model applies a uniform traction, not the parabolic shear that beam theory assumes; by St-Venant’s principle the difference fades within about one depth of the end.Ralat semakan itu sendiri (lajur kedua berbanding ketiga): 0.03% di tengah rentang tetapi 32% pada x = 3.5 m. Berhampiran hujung berbeban, model mengenakan traction seragam, bukan shear parabola yang diandaikan oleh beam theory; menurut St-Venant’s principle, perbezaan itu pudar dalam kira-kira satu kedalaman dari hujung.
Where to read a stressDi mana membaca stressAt element centroids, on a mesh that has converged, at least one depth away from supports and concentrated loads. Use beam theory there as the check, and quote the difference with its sign.Pada centroid element, pada mesh yang telah converge, sekurang-kurangnya satu kedalaman jauh dari support dan load tertumpu. A smooth plot is not an accurate plotPlot yang licin bukan plot yang tepatAveraging hides the jumps; it does not remove the error. Look at the unaveraged plot first: the size of the jump between neighbours is a free estimate of the local error.Purata menyembunyikan lompatan; ia tidak menghapuskan ralat. Lihat plot unaveraged dahulu: saiz lompatan antara jiran ialah anggaran percuma bagi ralat setempat.

The fixed corner never convergesBucu tetap tidak pernah converge

4-node meshMesh 4-nodecentroid of the top-left element (m)centroid element kiri atas (m)FE σxxbeam theory therebeam theory di situFE / beam
8 × 4(0.25, 1.75)413442190.98
16 × 8(0.125, 1.875)537250861.06
32 × 16(0.0625, 1.9375)640055371.16
64 × 32(0.031, 1.969)746757671.30

Every halving of the elements raises the peak, and it passes beam theory, which itself tends to 6000 kN m−2 at the corner. The elastic solution at the re-entrant corner of a fully fixed edge is infinite: refining chases infinity. A point load produces the same kind of singularity under it.Setiap kali saiz element dibahagi dua, puncaknya meningkat, dan ia melepasi beam theory, yang sendiri menghampiri 6000 kN m−2 di bucu itu. Penyelesaian elastic pada re-entrant corner bagi tepi yang tetap sepenuhnya ialah infiniti: refine bermakna mengejar infiniti. Point load menghasilkan singularity yang sama di bawahnya.

Singularity or concentration?Singularity atau concentration?A singularity (a fully fixed corner, a point load, a sharp re-entrant corner) has no finite peak: the peak grows with every refinement and must not be reported. A stress concentration (a smooth hole, a fillet) has a finite peak: it converges, and once checked it is the number the design needs.Singularity (bucu yang tetap sepenuhnya, point load, re-entrant corner yang tajam) tiada puncak terhingga: puncaknya meningkat dengan setiap refine dan tidak boleh dilaporkan. Stress concentration (lubang yang licin, fillet) mempunyai puncak terhingga: ia converge, dan setelah disemak, itulah nombor yang diperlukan reka bentuk.

The net-section check: the nominal stress across the remaining width is 10.0/(1 − 0.3) = 14.3 MPa, and 33.4/14.3 = 2.34. That is the kind of independent check the project asks for.Semakan keratan bersih: stress nominal merentasi lebar yang tinggal ialah 10.0/(1 − 0.3) = 14.3 MPa, dan 33.4/14.3 = 2.34. Itulah jenis semakan bebas yang diminta dalam projek.

Key pointsPerkara utama
  • Elemental mean = centroids; Unaveraged shows the jumps; Averaged is smooth but not more accurate.Elemental mean = centroid; Unaveraged menunjukkan lompatan; Averaged licin tetapi tidak lebih tepat.
  • Fixed corner: 4134 → 5372 → 6400 → 7467 kN m−2, no limit. Never report a peak at a singularity.Bucu tetap: 4134 → 5372 → 6400 → 7467 kN m−2, tiada had. Jangan sekali-kali laporkan puncak pada singularity.
  • A smooth hole converges: Kt = 2.34 against Peterson’s 2.35.Lubang yang licin converge: Kt = 2.34 berbanding 2.35 Peterson.

Your model shows its highest von Mises stress right at a fully fixed corner, and the value grows when you refine. YouModel anda menunjukkan von Mises stress tertinggi tepat pada bucu yang tetap sepenuhnya, dan nilainya meningkat apabila anda refine. Anda

A peak that grows without limit is a singularity of the idealised support, not a property of the structure. Show the divergence in the mesh study, then report values outside the corner zone, or model the real support (a bearing, a flexible wall) so the peak becomes finite.Puncak yang meningkat tanpa had ialah singularity bagi support yang diidealkan, bukan sifat struktur. Tunjukkan divergence dalam kajian mesh, kemudian laporkan nilai di luar zon bucu, atau modelkan support sebenar (bearing, dinding fleksibel) supaya puncak menjadi terhingga.

5. The 8-node element8-node element

≈ 8 min

The 8-node (serendipity) element adds a node at the middle of each side. Its displacement field is quadratic along every side, so the sides can curve, and that is its whole advantage in bending: a bent beam has curved fibres, and an element whose sides must stay straight can only imitate them by shearing (Example 3).8-node (serendipity) element menambah satu node di tengah setiap sisi. Displacement field-nya quadratic di sepanjang setiap sisi, jadi sisinya boleh melengkung, dan itulah keseluruhan kelebihannya dalam bending: beam yang melentur mempunyai fibre melengkung, dan element yang sisinya mesti kekal lurus hanya boleh meniru lengkungan itu dengan shear (Contoh 3).

The recipe is unchanged: [B] = [∂]ᵀ[N] and [k] = t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA, now 16 × 16 with 3 × 3 Gauss points. Nobody computes it by hand; the text lists it in its MATLAB code (§3.4.2).Resipinya tidak berubah: [B] = [∂]ᵀ[N] dan [k] = t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA, kini 16 × 16 dengan 3 × 3 Gauss point. Tiada siapa mengiranya dengan tangan; teks menyenaraikannya dalam kod MATLAB-nya (§3.4.2).

Edge loads on a three-node sideEdge load pada sisi tiga node

Along a side the quadratic shape functions integrate to ℓ/6, 2ℓ/3 and ℓ/6, so a uniform edge load is no longer shared half and half: the mid-side node takes two thirds.Di sepanjang sisi, shape function quadratic ber-integral kepada ℓ/6, 2ℓ/3 dan ℓ/6, jadi edge load seragam tidak lagi dibahagi separuh-separuh: node tengah sisi mengambil dua pertiga.

The quadratic edge shape functions integrate to ℓ/6, 2ℓ/3 and ℓ/6, so the mid-side node takes two thirds and each corner one sixth; the total is qℓ. qℓ/2 is the share of the middle node of two 4-node sides.Shape function tepi quadratic ber-integral kepada ℓ/6, 2ℓ/3 dan ℓ/6, jadi node tengah sisi mengambil dua pertiga dan setiap bucu satu perenam; jumlahnya qℓ. qℓ/2 ialah bahagian node tengah bagi dua sisi 4-node.

6. Reporting an FE result, and the projectMelaporkan keputusan FE, dan projek

≈ 8 min

A number without a mesh study and a check is an opinion. The project is marked on whether your numbers can be defended, and so is any FE result you will sign in practice.Nombor tanpa kajian mesh dan semakan hanyalah pendapat. Projek dinilai berdasarkan sama ada nombor anda boleh dipertahankan, dan begitu juga mana-mana keputusan FE yang akan anda tandatangani dalam amalan.

Four things every results section needsEmpat perkara yang wajib ada dalam setiap bahagian keputusan

  1. Idealisation stated. Plane stress or plane strain and why; thickness; E and ν with units; supports and loads with a sketch; what was left out (self-weight, openings, reinforcement).Idealisation dinyatakan. Plane stress atau plane strain dan sebabnya; ketebalan; E dan ν dengan unit; support dan load dengan lakaran; apa yang ditinggalkan (berat sendiri, bukaan, tetulang).
  2. A convergence table. At least three meshes, the quantity of interest for each, the change between the last two in per cent, and which mesh the results come from. Three meshes also give an error estimate (Example 2).Convergence table. Sekurang-kurangnya tiga mesh, kuantiti yang dikehendaki bagi setiap satu, perubahan antara dua yang terakhir dalam peratus, dan mesh mana yang menjadi sumber keputusan. Tiga mesh juga memberi anggaran ralat (Contoh 2).
  3. One independent check. Beam theory away from the ends, equilibrium of the reactions against the loads, a textbook stress-concentration factor, or a hand calculation on a coarse mesh. Quote the difference with its sign.Satu semakan bebas. Beam theory jauh dari hujung, keseimbangan reaction berbanding load, stress-concentration factor dari buku teks, atau pengiraan tangan pada mesh kasar. Nyatakan perbezaan bersama tandanya.
  4. Quantified conclusions. “The tip deflection is 0.191 m, within 0.7% of beam theory”, not “the results agree well”. Say where the maximum is, what it means for the design, and what the model cannot tell you.Kesimpulan yang dikuantifikasi. “Tip deflection ialah 0.191 m, dalam 0.7% daripada beam theory”, bukan “keputusan sepadan dengan baik”. Nyatakan di mana maksimum, apa maksudnya untuk reka bentuk, dan apa yang model tidak dapat beritahu.

Model paragraph · the cantilever in five sentencesPerenggan model · cantilever dalam lima ayat

The cantilever (4 m × 2 m, t = 0.01 m, E = 200 × 10⁶ N m−2, ν = 0.33) was idealised as plane stress with the left edge fully fixed and the 5 kN m−1 end load applied as an edge traction. Four-node meshes of 2 × 2, 8 × 4, 16 × 8 and 32 × 16 elements gave tip deflections of 0.131, 0.182, 0.189 and 0.191 m; the change between the last two meshes is 1.0%, so the 32 × 16 results are reported. Timoshenko beam theory gives 0.192 m (0.160 m bending, 0.032 m shear), 0.7% above the FE value. The bending stress at element centroids at mid-span agrees with M(y − 1)/I to within 0.25%; the stress at the fixed corner increases without bound under refinement and is not reported. The reactions sum to 10.0 kN upward and 40.0 kN m, equal to the applied load and its moment.(Ditulis dalam bahasa Inggeris kerana laporan projek ditulis dalam bahasa Inggeris.) Answer. (c) σxx = ∓1.65 MPa in elements 1 and 3 (beam theory ∓2.25 MPa); σxy = −0.50 MPa (average V/tH = 0.50 MPa).

Step 5 (d) Reactions(d) Reaction[3]

The struck rows of [K]{U} − {R} at the fixed nodes (no load acts there) give the reactions (Rx, Ry):Baris yang dibuang [K]{U} − {R} pada node tetap (tiada load bertindak di situ) memberi reaction (Rx, Ry):

Check. They balance the 10 kN load and its 40 kN m moment about the support.

Step 6 (e) Accuracy(e) Ketepatan[4]

The tip deflection, at the corners of the free end, is 0.1306 m. Finer meshes of the course solver:Tip deflection, pada bucu hujung bebas, ialah 0.1306 m. Mesh lebih halus daripada solver kursus:

mesh2 × 24 × 28 × 416 × 832 × 16128 × 64beam
tip (m)tip (m)0.13060.16430.18240.18860.19060.19150.1919
Answer. (e) The 2 × 2 mesh gives 68% of the deflection and 73% of the bending stress; about 16 × 8 elements are needed to come within 2%.
InterpretationTafsiranA Q4 element is too stiff in bending. Its sides stay straight, so it can rotate a section only by shearing, and the spurious shear stores energy that resists the bending (Example 3). That is why the 2 × 2 mesh deflects a third less than it should and its centroid stresses are a quarter low; it improves only as the elements become short compared with the depth, or with Q8 elements, whose two-element mesh is 7% low. The reactions, by contrast, are exact in total: the 10 kN and the 40 kN m follow from equilibrium of the whole plate whatever the mesh, although their split among nodes 1, 4 and 7 is not.Q4 element terlalu kaku dalam bending. Sisinya kekal lurus, jadi ia hanya boleh memutar keratan dengan shear, dan shear palsu itu menyimpan tenaga yang menentang bending (Contoh 3). Itulah sebabnya mesh 2 × 2 melendut satu pertiga kurang daripada sepatutnya dan stress centroid-nya rendah satu perempat; ia bertambah baik hanya apabila element menjadi pendek berbanding kedalaman, atau dengan Q8 element, yang mesh dua element-nya rendah 7%. Reaction pula tepat secara jumlah: 10 kN dan 40 kN m terhasil daripada keseimbangan seluruh plat tanpa mengira mesh, walaupun pembahagiannya antara node 1, 4 dan 7 tidak tepat.

Example 2 · How far is the finest mesh from the answer? An error estimate from three meshesContoh 2 · Sejauh mana mesh paling halus dari jawapan? Anggaran ralat daripada tiga mesh

Exam typeJenis soalan interpret computer results without an exact solutionUnitsUnit mSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Example 10.5 (method), with the cantilever results of Example 9.715 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalanThe cantilever of Example 1, modelled with Q4 meshes of 8 × 4, 16 × 8 and 32 × 16 elements, gives tip deflections of 0.1824, 0.1886 and 0.1906 m. (a) Estimate the rate of convergence. (b) Estimate the converged deflection with the measured rate, and with the rate p = 2 of smooth problems. (c) Estimate the error of the 32 × 16 result. (d) A 128 × 64 mesh gives 0.1915 m and Timoshenko beam theory 0.1919 m. Comment.Cantilever dalam Contoh 1, dimodelkan dengan mesh Q4 8 × 4, 16 × 8 dan 32 × 16 element, memberi tip deflection 0.1824, 0.1886 dan 0.1906 m. (a) Anggarkan kadar convergence. (b) Anggarkan deflection yang converge dengan kadar yang diukur, dan dengan kadar p = 2 bagi masalah licin. (c) Anggarkan ralat keputusan 32 × 16. (d) Mesh 128 × 64 memberi 0.1915 m dan Timoshenko beam theory 0.1919 m. Ulas.

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. Each halving of the elements moves the deflection up by a smaller step. If the steps shrink by a fixed factor 2p, the remaining distance to the converged value is a fixed multiple of the last step, which is what (10.1) uses. For a smooth problem a Q4 nodal value has p = 2; the clamped corner of the cantilever, where the elastic stress is singular, should lower it.Setiap kali saiz element dibahagi dua, deflection naik dengan langkah yang lebih kecil. Jika langkah mengecil dengan faktor tetap 2p, jarak yang tinggal ke nilai converge ialah gandaan tetap bagi langkah terakhir, dan itulah yang digunakan oleh (10.1). Bagi masalah licin, nilai node Q4 mempunyai p = 2; bucu terkapit cantilever, di mana stress elastic singular, sepatutnya merendahkannya.

Plan. Successive changes → 2p and p → (10.1) with the measured p and with p = 2 → error of the finest mesh → compare with the 128 × 64 result and with beam theory.

(10.1)

Step 1 (a) The rate(a) Kadar[4]

Answer. (a) The changes shrink by 3.1 per halving: p ≈ 1.6, below the 2 of a smooth problem.

Step 2 (b) The converged value(b) Nilai converge[4]

Answer. (b) About 0.1916 m with the measured rate; 0.1913 m if p = 2 is assumed.

Step 3 (c) Error of the finest mesh(c) Ralat mesh paling halus[3]

Answer. (c) The 32 × 16 deflection is about 0.5% below the converged value; assuming p = 2 would understate that error by about a third.

Step 4 (d) Comment(d) Ulasan[4]

The extrapolation from three meshes lands within 0.03% of a mesh with sixteen times as many elements as the finest of them, at a fraction of its cost. The assumed p = 2 falls short because the clamped corner slows the convergence; a third mesh is what reveals that. Beam theory is not the reference for the mesh error: it is a different model (a shear coefficient of 5/6 and no restraint of the Poisson contraction at the support), and its 0.2% difference from the converged plane-stress answer is a modelling difference, not a mesh error.Ekstrapolasi daripada tiga mesh mendarat dalam 0.03% daripada mesh yang mempunyai enam belas kali ganda bilangan element mesh paling halus antaranya, dengan kos yang jauh lebih rendah. Andaian p = 2 tidak mencukupi kerana bucu terkapit melambatkan convergence; mesh ketiga yang mendedahkannya. Beam theory bukan rujukan untuk ralat mesh: ia model yang berbeza (shear coefficient 5/6 dan tiada kekangan Poisson contraction pada support), dan perbezaan 0.2% daripada jawapan plane stress yang converge ialah perbezaan pemodelan, bukan ralat mesh.

InterpretationTafsiranThree meshes turn computer results into an answer with an error estimate, without an exact solution, which is the normal situation in practice and the convergence table the project asks for. The estimate is only as good as the assumption that the error follows hp: check the rate with the third mesh, and distrust an extrapolation whose steps do not shrink by a steady factor. At the fixed corner itself the stresses do not shrink at all (Notes §4), so no extrapolation is possible there.Tiga mesh menukar keputusan komputer kepada jawapan dengan anggaran ralat, tanpa penyelesaian tepat, iaitu keadaan biasa dalam amalan dan convergence table yang diminta dalam projek. Anggaran itu hanya sebaik andaian bahawa ralat mengikut hp: semak kadarnya dengan mesh ketiga, dan jangan percaya ekstrapolasi yang langkahnya tidak mengecil dengan faktor yang tetap. Pada bucu tetap itu sendiri stress langsung tidak mengecil (Nota §4), jadi ekstrapolasi tidak mungkin di situ.

Example 3 · Why a Q4 element is too stiff in bending, and which refinement helpsContoh 3 · Mengapa Q4 element terlalu kaku dalam bending, dan refine mana yang membantu

Exam typeJenis soalan explain an inaccurate result; choose a meshUnitsUnit N, mSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Example 10.620 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalan(a) A Q4 element in plane stress, of length a and depth b, is bent by equal and opposite couples on its two ends, which stay straight. Show where its strain field departs from pure bending, and find the ratio of its end rotation to the exact one. (b) The cantilever of Example 1 gives these tip deflections, as percentages of a 128 × 64 mesh (0.1915 m). Which refinement helps, and why? (c) What does an 8-node element change?(a) Satu Q4 element dalam plane stress, panjang a dan dalam b, dilentur oleh couple yang sama dan bertentangan pada dua hujungnya, yang kekal lurus. Tunjukkan di mana strain field-nya berbeza daripada pure bending, dan cari nisbah putaran hujungnya kepada nilai tepat. (b) Cantilever dalam Contoh 1 memberi tip deflection berikut, sebagai peratus mesh 128 × 64 (0.1915 m). Refine mana yang membantu, dan mengapa? (c) Apa yang diubah oleh 8-node element?
mesh (along × through)mesh (sepanjang × merentas)2 × 22 × 42 × 84 × 28 × 28 × 416 × 8
%68.269.670.185.891.995.298.5

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. In pure bending the top and bottom fibres curve while the ends stay plane and square to them. The sides of a Q4 element stay straight, so its ends can rotate only by shearing the element. That shear stores energy which the real block does not have, and the element resists bending more than it should.Dalam pure bending, fibre atas dan bawah melengkung manakala hujung kekal rata dan tegak kepadanya. Sisi Q4 element kekal lurus, jadi hujungnya hanya boleh berputar dengan meng-shear element itu. Shear itu menyimpan tenaga yang tiada pada blok sebenar, dan element itu menentang bending lebih daripada sepatutnya.

Plan. Bilinear bending field → its strains → strain energy → moment–rotation → ratio → the cantilever table → Q8.

Step 1 (a) The strain field(a) Strain field[4]

Let the element bend to a curvature κ′, with the origin at its centre, so that its ends turn by ±κ′a/2. The bilinear field that does this isBiarkan element melentur kepada kelengkungan κ′, dengan origin di pusatnya, supaya hujungnya berputar ±κ′a/2. Field bilinear yang melakukannya ialah

The exact field has γxy = 0 and εyy = −νεxx. The element has a shear strain that grows towards its ends — the parasitic shear — and no lateral strain, because v would need a y² term.Field tepat mempunyai γxy = 0 dan εyy = −νεxx. Element itu mempunyai shear strain yang bertambah ke arah hujungnya — parasitic shear — dan tiada lateral strain, kerana v memerlukan term y².

Step 2 (a) Strain energy(a) Tenaga strain[4]

With εyy = 0, σxx = Ēεxx, and per unit thicknessDengan εyy = 0, σxx = Ēεxx, dan per unit ketebalan

Step 3 (a) Moment and the ratio of rotations(a) Momen dan nisbah putaran[5]

Answer. (a) γxy = −κ′x ≠ 0 and εyy = 0; θQ4/θexact = (1 − ν²)/[1 + (1 − ν)(a/b)²/2], 0.67 for a square element with ν = 0.3.

Check. A one-element computation with the course solver, end couples applied as consistent loads, gives 0.837, 0.674, 0.379 and 0.138: the same four ratios.

Step 4 (b) The cantilever(b) Cantilever[4]

Refining through the depth only, 2 × 2 → 2 × 4 → 2 × 8, moves the deflection from 68.2 to 70.1%. Every layer of elements carries the same parasitic shear, whatever its depth: what governs is the element length over the depth of the member, a/B, which stays 1. Refining along the length, 2 × 2 → 4 × 2 → 8 × 2, raises it to 85.8 and 91.9%, because a/B falls to 0.5 and 0.25. With both, 8 × 4 and 16 × 8 reach 95.2 and 98.5% at a/B = 0.25 and 0.125.Refine merentas kedalaman sahaja, 2 × 2 → 2 × 4 → 2 × 8, mengubah deflection dari 68.2 kepada 70.1%. Setiap lapisan element membawa parasitic shear yang sama, tanpa mengira kedalamannya: yang menentukan ialah panjang element berbanding kedalaman anggota, a/B, yang kekal 1. Refine di sepanjang panjang, 2 × 2 → 4 × 2 → 8 × 2, menaikkannya kepada 85.8 dan 91.9%, kerana a/B turun kepada 0.5 dan 0.25. Dengan kedua-duanya, 8 × 4 dan 16 × 8 mencapai 95.2 dan 98.5% pada a/B = 0.25 dan 0.125.

Answer. (b) Refine along the length, so that the elements are short compared with the depth of the member; refining through the depth alone gains less than 2 points.

Step 5 (c) The 8-node element(c) 8-node element[3]

Its sides are quadratic, so they can curve and pure bending needs no shear. Two Q8 elements give 0.1780 m (92.9%) and a 4 × 2 Q8 mesh 0.1885 m (98.4%), against 68.2% for four Q4 elements.Sisinya quadratic, jadi ia boleh melengkung dan pure bending tidak memerlukan shear. Dua Q8 element memberi 0.1780 m (92.9%) dan mesh Q8 4 × 2 memberi 0.1885 m (98.4%), berbanding 68.2% bagi empat Q4 element.

Answer. (c) Q8 removes the parasitic shear: two elements are 7% low where four Q4 are 32% low.
InterpretationTafsiranThe Q4 fails in bending for a reason that can be seen in one element: its straight sides force a shear strain that pure bending does not have, and relative to the bending energy that shear energy grows with (a/b)². The error therefore depends on how the elements are arranged, not only on how many there are, and an analyst can control it: where a member bends, refine along its length until the elements are short compared with its depth, or use an element whose sides can bend. That is the reason Workbench meshes 2D solids with PLANE183, the 8-node element.Q4 gagal dalam bending atas sebab yang boleh dilihat dalam satu element: sisinya yang lurus memaksa shear strain yang tiada dalam pure bending, dan berbanding tenaga bending, tenaga shear itu bertambah dengan (a/b)². Jadi ralat bergantung pada susunan element, bukan hanya bilangannya, dan penganalisis boleh mengawalnya: di mana anggota melentur, refine di sepanjang panjangnya sehingga element pendek berbanding kedalamannya, atau gunakan element yang sisinya boleh melentur. Itulah sebab Workbench menggunakan PLANE183, iaitu 8-node element, untuk 2D solid.

A1 · 1 markmarkah
Order the operations that take the solved nodal displacements to a stress at a point.Susun operasi yang membawa nodal displacement yang diselesaikan kepada stress pada satu titik.

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

Locate first, because [B] must be evaluated at the local coordinates of the point in the element that contains it; then strains, then stresses. [k]{û} gives nodal forces, not stresses.Cari dahulu, kerana [B] mesti dinilai pada koordinat local titik itu dalam element yang mengandunginya; kemudian strain, kemudian stress. [k]{û} memberi nodal force, bukan stress.

A2 · 1 markmarkah
In a displacement-based model, why are the stresses less accurate than the displacements?Dalam model berasaskan displacement, mengapa stress kurang tepat berbanding displacement?

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

The method solves for nodal displacements; strains come from differentiating the shape functions, which loses one order of accuracy, and each element differentiates its own field, so the stresses jump at shared sides. [E] is exact for the idealisation; consistent loads are not lumped.Kaedah ini menyelesaikan nodal displacement; strain datang daripada membezakan shape function, yang kehilangan satu peringkat ketepatan, dan setiap element membezakan field sendiri, jadi stress melompat pada sisi yang dikongsi. [E] tepat bagi idealisation itu; consistent load tidak dikumpulkan.

A3 · 1 markmarkah
Which display option shows the jumps of stress between neighbouring elements?Pilihan paparan mana yang menunjukkan lompatan stress antara element yang berjiran?

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

Unaveraged shows each element’s own values at its nodes, so two values meet at every shared node and the jump is visible. Elemental mean shows one value per element; Averaged smooths the jumps away without removing the error.Unaveraged menunjukkan nilai setiap element sendiri pada node-nya, jadi dua nilai bertemu pada setiap node yang dikongsi dan lompatannya kelihatan. Elemental mean menunjukkan satu nilai setiap element; Averaged melicinkan lompatan tanpa menghapuskan ralat.

A4 · 1 markmarkah
σxx next to the fully fixed corner rises 4134 → 5372 → 6400 → 7467 kN m−2 as the elements are halved. What do you report?σxx bersebelahan bucu yang tetap sepenuhnya meningkat 4134 → 5372 → 6400 → 7467 kN m−2 apabila element dibahagi dua. Apa yang anda laporkan?

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

The steps do not shrink (1238, 1028, 1067), so there is no limit to extrapolate to: the elastic stress at a fully fixed re-entrant corner is infinite. Report values outside the corner zone or model the support realistically.Langkahnya tidak mengecil (1238, 1028, 1067), jadi tiada had untuk diekstrapolasi: stress elastic pada re-entrant corner yang tetap sepenuhnya ialah infiniti. Laporkan nilai di luar zon bucu atau modelkan support secara realistik.

A5 · 1 markmarkah
Two meshes of 8-node elements, 2 × 1 and 4 × 2, give tip deflections of 0.1780 and 0.1885 m (converged 0.1915). Four 4-node elements give 0.1306 m. The main reason the Q8 does better per element is thatDua mesh 8-node element, 2 × 1 dan 4 × 2, memberi tip deflection 0.1780 dan 0.1885 m (converge 0.1915). Empat 4-node element memberi 0.1306 m. Sebab utama Q8 lebih baik bagi setiap element ialah

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

A Q4 keeps its sides straight and can rotate a section only by shearing; the parasitic shear stores energy and resists bending (Example 3). The quadratic sides of a Q8 take the curved shape of a bent beam. More Gauss points are a consequence of the higher order, not the cause.Q4 mengekalkan sisinya lurus dan hanya boleh memutar keratan dengan shear; parasitic shear menyimpan tenaga dan menentang bending (Contoh 3). Sisi quadratic Q8 mengambil bentuk melengkung beam yang melentur. Lebih banyak Gauss point ialah akibat order yang lebih tinggi, bukan sebabnya.

A6 · 1 markmarkah
A results section reads: “Four meshes were run and the results agree well with theory.” What is missing?Satu bahagian keputusan berbunyi: “Four meshes were run and the results agree well with theory.” Apa yang tiada?

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

The standard is a convergence table plus a signed, quantified comparison with an independent check. “Agree well” is an opinion; a contour plot without numbers does not verify anything.Piawainya ialah convergence table serta perbandingan yang dikuantifikasi dan bertanda dengan semakan bebas. “Agree well” ialah pendapat; contour plot tanpa nombor tidak mengesahkan apa-apa.

C1 · 2 marksmarkah
A student recovers the stresses at (3.5, 1.3) m of the 2 × 2 cantilever (E = 200 × 10⁶ N m−2, ν = 0.33, Ē = 224.44 × 10⁶ N m−2). One line contains the slip. Which one?Seorang pelajar mendapatkan semula stress pada (3.5, 1.3) m bagi cantilever 2 × 2 (E = 200 × 10⁶ N m−2, ν = 0.33, Ē = 224.44 × 10⁶ N m−2). Satu baris mengandungi kesilapan. Yang mana?

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

Line 4: the shear row of [E] for plane stress is Ē(1 − ν)/2 = 75.19 × 10⁶ N m−2, which equals G = E/(2(1 + ν)). So σxy = 75.19(−4.1348) = −310.9 kN m−2, and line 5 becomes σvM = 636.8 kN m−2. The check that catches it: the shear entry must equal G, and a shear stress three times σxx near a free end is implausible.Baris 4: baris shear [E] bagi plane stress ialah Ē(1 − ν)/2 = 75.19 × 10⁶ N m−2, yang sama dengan G = E/(2(1 + ν)). Jadi σxy = 75.19(−4.1348) = −310.9 kN m−2, dan baris 5 menjadi σvM = 636.8 kN m−2. Semakan yang menangkapnya: entri shear mesti sama dengan G, dan shear stress tiga kali σxx berhampiran hujung bebas tidak munasabah.

"""
SEAA 4243 Finite Element Method - plane stress with 4-node and 8-node elements
==============================================================================

Companion code for the Cantilever and Stress Recovery Explorers (Plane Stress).
It follows the course's steps in the text's notation (Mohd Yassin et al.,
MSNM 2020, Chapter 3):

    [E]   3 x 3 material matrix, plane stress or plane strain       text (3.10)
    [B]   strains from nodal displacements, {eps} = [d]^T[N]{u}     weak form (3.31)-(3.38)
    [k]   = t * integral [B]^T [E] [B] dA                          closed form (3.42);
          here by Gauss quadrature (2 x 2 points for the 4-node
          element, 3 x 3 for the 8-node), which reproduces (3.42)
    loads a uniform traction on the free end becomes consistent nodal
          loads: q b/2 to each node (4-node, (3.45)); q b/6, 2q b/3,
          q b/6 (8-node, (3.51))
    solve assemble (3.46), strike the fixed edge's rows and columns
          (3.48), solve (3.49); reactions from the struck rows;
          stresses {sigma} = [E][B]{u} at any point; principal stresses,
          von Mises, and nodal averaging as in ANSYS.

The built-in problem is the text's cantilever: a plate 4 m x 2 m,
t = 0.01 m, E = 200e6 N/m2, nu = 0.33, fixed at x = 0, loaded at x = 4 by a
uniform downward traction of 5000 N per metre of edge (P = 10 kN in total).
The functions take any L, H, mesh, material, thickness and load.

Mesh and numbering
    4-node: nodes left to right, then bottom to top (the text's 2 x 2 mesh:
    nodes 1-3 along the bottom). dof 2i-1 = u_i, dof 2i = v_i (1-based).
    8-node: corner and mid-side nodes are numbered in the order they are
    created; use node_at(res, x, y) to find a node.

Units
    Any consistent set. The example uses N and m, so stresses come out in
    N/m2 (divide by 1e3 for kN/m2). The traction q is force per unit length
    of the loaded edge (N/m), the thickness already included.

Run
    python fe_plane_stress.py
        reproduces the 2 x 2 cantilever (tip deflection, reactions, stresses
        at (3.5, 1.3)), the convergence of the 4- and 8-node meshes against
        Timoshenko beam theory, and the growth of the stress at the fixed
        corner; saves a von Mises contour plot if matplotlib is installed.

Use for your own model
    from fe_plane_stress import solve_cantilever, stress_at, principal, von_mises
    res = solve_cantilever(L=4, H=2, Nx=8, Ny=4, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000, nen=8)
    s = stress_at(res, 2.0, 1.3)        # (sxx, syy, sxy)

A hand calculation is still a hand calculation: use this script to check your
matrices and numbers, and to run the mesh study a project needs.
Dense numpy solver: fine up to a few thousand degrees of freedom.

Requires Python 3.8+ and numpy; matplotlib only for the plot.
Course SEAA 4243, Faculty of Civil Engineering, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia.
Code: MIT licence.
"""
import numpy as np


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Material
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def E_matrix(E, nu, plane="stress"):
    """[E] of text (3.10) for plane stress; plane strain when plane = "strain"."""
    if plane == "stress":
        c = E / (1 - nu ** 2)
        return c * np.array([[1, nu, 0], [nu, 1, 0], [0, 0, (1 - nu) / 2]])
    c = E / ((1 + nu) * (1 - 2 * nu))
    return c * np.array([[1 - nu, nu, 0], [nu, 1 - nu, 0], [0, 0, (1 - 2 * nu) / 2]])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shape functions in natural coordinates xi, eta in [-1, 1]
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XI = np.array([-1, 1, 1, -1, 0, 1, 0, -1], dtype=float)
ETA = np.array([-1, -1, 1, 1, -1, 0, 1, 0], dtype=float)


def shape(nen, xi, eta):
    """N (nen,) and dN/dxi, dN/deta (2, nen) of the 4-node or 8-node element."""
    if nen == 4:
        N = 0.25 * (1 + XI[:4] * xi) * (1 + ETA[:4] * eta)
        dN = np.vstack([0.25 * XI[:4] * (1 + ETA[:4] * eta), 0.25 * ETA[:4] * (1 + XI[:4] * xi)])
        return N, dN
    N = np.zeros(8); dN = np.zeros((2, 8))
    for i in range(4):
        cx, cy = XI[i], ETA[i]
        N[i] = 0.25 * (1 + cx * xi) * (1 + cy * eta) * (cx * xi + cy * eta - 1)
        dN[0, i] = 0.25 * cx * (1 + cy * eta) * (2 * cx * xi + cy * eta)
        dN[1, i] = 0.25 * cy * (1 + cx * xi) * (cx * xi + 2 * cy * eta)
    N[4] = 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2) * (1 - eta); dN[:, 4] = [-xi * (1 - eta), -0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2)]
    N[5] = 0.5 * (1 + xi) * (1 - eta ** 2); dN[:, 5] = [0.5 * (1 - eta ** 2), -eta * (1 + xi)]
    N[6] = 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2) * (1 + eta); dN[:, 6] = [-xi * (1 + eta), 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2)]
    N[7] = 0.5 * (1 - xi) * (1 - eta ** 2); dN[:, 7] = [-0.5 * (1 - eta ** 2), -eta * (1 - xi)]
    return N, dN


def B_matrix(nen, a, b, xi, eta):
    """[B] (3 x 2nen) of an a x b rectangle at (xi, eta): rows exx, eyy, gamma_xy."""
    _, dN = shape(nen, xi, eta)
    dx, dy = dN[0] * 2 / a, dN[1] * 2 / b
    B = np.zeros((3, 2 * nen))
    B[0, 0::2] = dx
    B[1, 1::2] = dy
    B[2, 0::2] = dy
    B[2, 1::2] = dx
    return B


def element_stiffness(nen, a, b, Em, t):
    """[k] = t * integral [B]^T[E][B] dA by Gauss quadrature (2 x 2 for Q4, 3 x 3 for Q8)."""
    g, w = np.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(2 if nen == 4 else 3)
    k = np.zeros((2 * nen, 2 * nen))
    for xi, wi in zip(g, w):
        for eta, wj in zip(g, w):
            B = B_matrix(nen, a, b, xi, eta)
            k += t * (a / 2) * (b / 2) * wi * wj * B.T @ Em @ B
    return k


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mesh
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def mesh(nen, L, H, Nx, Ny):
    a, b = L / Nx, H / Ny
    if nen == 4:
        nodes = np.array([(i * a, j * b) for j in range(Ny + 1) for i in range(Nx + 1)], dtype=float)
        conn = [[j * (Nx + 1) + i, j * (Nx + 1) + i + 1, (j + 1) * (Nx + 1) + i + 1, (j + 1) * (Nx + 1) + i]
                for j in range(Ny) for i in range(Nx)]
        return a, b, nodes, np.array(conn, dtype=int)
    ids, nodes = {}, []
    def node(x, y):
        key = (round(x, 9), round(y, 9))
        if key not in ids:
            ids[key] = len(nodes); nodes.append((x, y))
        return ids[key]
    conn = []
    for j in range(Ny):
        for i in range(Nx):
            x0, y0 = i * a, j * b
            conn.append([node(x0, y0), node(x0 + a, y0), node(x0 + a, y0 + b), node(x0, y0 + b),
                         node(x0 + a / 2, y0), node(x0 + a, y0 + b / 2), node(x0 + a / 2, y0 + b), node(x0, y0 + b / 2)])
    return a, b, np.array(nodes, dtype=float), np.array(conn, dtype=int)


def dofs_of(c):
    return np.ravel([[2 * n, 2 * n + 1] for n in c])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve the cantilever
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def solve_cantilever(L=4.0, H=2.0, Nx=2, Ny=2, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000.0,
                     nen=4, plane="stress", load="edge"):
    """Fixed at x = 0; vertical load on x = L. load = "edge": uniform traction q (N/m)
    by consistent nodal loads; load = "point": the total q*H at the top-right node."""
    Em = E_matrix(E, nu, plane)
    a, b, nodes, conn = mesh(nen, L, H, Nx, Ny)
    n = len(nodes)
    K = np.zeros((2 * n, 2 * n))
    F = np.zeros(2 * n)
    k = element_stiffness(nen, a, b, Em, t)
    for c in conn:
        d = dofs_of(c)
        K[np.ix_(d, d)] += k                                   # scatter-add by dof map
    if load == "point":
        F[2 * node_at_xy(nodes, L, H) + 1] += q * H
    else:
        for c in conn:
            if np.isclose(nodes[c[1], 0], L):                   # element side 2-3 on the loaded edge
                if nen == 4:
                    F[2 * c[1] + 1] += q * b / 2; F[2 * c[2] + 1] += q * b / 2
                else:
                    F[2 * c[1] + 1] += q * b / 6; F[2 * c[5] + 1] += 2 * q * b / 3; F[2 * c[2] + 1] += q * b / 6
    fixed_nodes = np.where(np.isclose(nodes[:, 0], 0.0))[0]
    known = dofs_of(fixed_nodes)
    free = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(2 * n), known)
    U = np.zeros(2 * n)
    U[free] = np.linalg.solve(K[np.ix_(free, free)], F[free])
    Rk = K[known] @ U - F[known]                               # struck rows: support reactions
    Rx, Ry = Rk[0::2].sum(), Rk[1::2].sum()
    M = sum(-(nodes[nd, 1] - H / 2) * Rk[2 * i] for i, nd in enumerate(fixed_nodes))
    return dict(nen=nen, L=L, H=H, Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, a=a, b=b, E=E, nu=nu, t=t, q=q, plane=plane, Em=Em,
                nodes=nodes, conn=conn, K=K, F=F, U=U, known=known, reactions=dict(Rx=Rx, Ry=Ry, M=M),
                tip=U[2 * node_at_xy(nodes, L, H) + 1])


def node_at_xy(nodes, x, y):
    return int(np.argmin(np.hypot(nodes[:, 0] - x, nodes[:, 1] - y)))


def node_at(res, x, y):
    """0-based index of the node nearest to (x, y)."""
    return node_at_xy(res["nodes"], x, y)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stresses
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def locate(res, x, y):
    """Element containing (x, y) and the natural coordinates of the point in it."""
    i = min(res["Nx"] - 1, max(0, int(np.floor(x / res["a"] + 1e-12))))
    j = min(res["Ny"] - 1, max(0, int(np.floor(y / res["b"] + 1e-12))))
    e = j * res["Nx"] + i
    x1, y1 = res["nodes"][res["conn"][e][0]]
    return e, 2 * (x - x1) / res["a"] - 1, 2 * (y - y1) / res["b"] - 1


def stress_in_element(res, e, xi, eta):
    c = res["conn"][e]
    B = B_matrix(res["nen"], res["a"], res["b"], xi, eta)
    return res["Em"] @ (B @ res["U"][dofs_of(c)])


def stress_at(res, x, y):
    """(sxx, syy, sxy) at a global point, from the element that contains it."""
    e, xi, eta = locate(res, x, y)
    return stress_in_element(res, e, xi, eta)


def principal(s):
    """sigma1, sigma2 and the angle (degrees) of sigma1 from x: the Mohr circle."""
    c = (s[0] + s[1]) / 2
    R = np.hypot((s[0] - s[1]) / 2, s[2])
    return c + R, c - R, 0.5 * np.degrees(np.arctan2(2 * s[2], s[0] - s[1]))


def von_mises(s):
    """Plane-stress von Mises stress."""
    return np.sqrt(s[0] ** 2 - s[0] * s[1] + s[1] ** 2 + 3 * s[2] ** 2)


def nodal_stresses(res, mode="averaged"):
    """Stresses at the nodes, as post-processors show them.
    "unaveraged": each element's own value at its nodes, (ne, nen, 3) - jumps visible;
    "averaged":   the mean over the elements sharing each node, (n, 3);
    "centroid":   one value per element, (ne, 3)."""
    nen, conn = res["nen"], res["conn"]
    if mode == "centroid":
        return np.array([stress_in_element(res, e, 0, 0) for e in range(len(conn))])
    un = np.array([[stress_in_element(res, e, XI[i], ETA[i]) for i in range(nen)] for e in range(len(conn))])
    if mode == "unaveraged":
        return un
    n = len(res["nodes"])
    av = np.zeros((n, 3)); cnt = np.zeros(n)
    for e, c in enumerate(conn):
        for i, nd in enumerate(c):
            av[nd] += un[e, i]; cnt[nd] += 1
    return av / cnt[:, None]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Beam theory for comparison
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def timoshenko_tip(L, H, E, nu, t, q, plane="stress", kappa=5 / 6):
    """Tip deflection magnitude: bending PL^3/(3EI) plus shear PL/(kappa G A)."""
    P = -q * H
    I, A, G = t * H ** 3 / 12, t * H, E / (2 * (1 + nu))
    Eb = E / (1 - nu ** 2) if plane == "strain" else E
    return P * L ** 3 / (3 * Eb * I), P * L / (kappa * G * A)


def plot_von_mises(res, filename="von_mises.png"):
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        from matplotlib.ticker import MaxNLocator
    except ImportError:
        print("matplotlib is not installed: skipping the plot")
        return None
    xs = np.linspace(0, res["L"], 161); ys = np.linspace(0, res["H"], 81)
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(xs, ys)
    Z = np.vectorize(lambda x, y: von_mises(stress_at(res, x, y)) / 1e3)(X, Y)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.6))
    # the fixed corners are singular: cap the colour scale at the 99th percentile
    levels = MaxNLocator(nbins=20).tick_values(0, np.percentile(Z, 99))
    cf = ax.contourf(X, Y, Z, levels=levels, cmap="jet", extend="max")
    ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.set_xlabel("x (m)"); ax.set_ylabel("y (m)")
    fig.colorbar(cf, ax=ax, label="von Mises (kN/m2)")
    ax.set_title(f"{res['nen']}-node, {res['Nx']} x {res['Ny']} mesh")
    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    print("saved", filename)
    return filename


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Course examples
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=140)
    base = dict(L=4.0, H=2.0, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000.0)

    r = solve_cantilever(Nx=2, Ny=2, **base)
    print("Text cantilever, 4-node 2 x 2 mesh, (3.44)-(3.49) (nodes 1-3 along the bottom)")
    U = r["U"].reshape(-1, 2)
    for i, (u, v) in enumerate(U):
        print(f"  node {i + 1}: u = {u:+.6f}  v = {v:+.6f} m")
    print(f"  tip deflection = {r['tip']:.4f} m  (text: -0.131)")
    R = r["reactions"]
    print(f"  reactions: Rx = {R['Rx']:.1f} N, Ry = {R['Ry']:.1f} N, M = {R['M']:.1f} N m  (10 kN up, 40 kN m)")
    s = stress_at(r, 3.5, 1.3) / 1e3
    s1, s2, th = principal(s)
    print(f"  stress at (3.5, 1.3) = {np.round(s, 1)} kN/m2  (315.2, -44.9, -310.9)")
    print(f"  principal {s1:.1f}, {s2:.1f} kN/m2 at {th:.1f} deg; von Mises {von_mises(s):.1f}  (494.4, -224.1; 636.8)")

    bend, shear = timoshenko_tip(**base)
    print(f"\nConvergence of the tip deflection; Timoshenko beam {bend:.3f} + {shear:.3f} = {bend + shear:.3f} m")
    for nen, meshes in ((4, [(2, 1), (2, 2), (4, 2), (8, 4), (16, 8), (32, 16)]), (8, [(2, 1), (4, 2), (8, 4), (16, 8)])):
        for Nx, Ny in meshes:
            rr = solve_cantilever(Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, nen=nen, **base)
            print(f"  {nen}-node {Nx:2d} x {Ny:<2d} dofs {rr['U'].size:5d}  tip {rr['tip']:.4f} m")

    r8 = solve_cantilever(Nx=16, Ny=8, nen=8, **base)
    print(f"\n8-node 16 x 8: sxx(2.0, 1.3) = {stress_at(r8, 2.0, 1.3)[0] / 1e3:.1f} kN/m2 (beam theory 900);"
          f" sxx(3.5, 1.3) = {stress_at(r8, 3.5, 1.3)[0] / 1e3:.1f} (beam 225: end effect, St-Venant)")

    print("\nFixed corner: sxx at the centroid of the top-left element grows with every refinement (a singularity)")
    for Nx, Ny in ((8, 4), (16, 8), (32, 16)):
        rr = solve_cantilever(Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, **base)
        print(f"  4-node {Nx} x {Ny}: {stress_at(rr, rr['a'] / 2, 2 - rr['b'] / 2)[0] / 1e3:.0f} kN/m2")

    plot_von_mises(r8, "von_mises_q8_16x8.png")

GlossaryGlosari

What to doApa perlu dibuat Look up a term; type in the box to filter. Terms stay in English in both languages; the explanation follows the language you chose.Cari istilah; taip dalam kotak untuk menapis. Istilah kekal dalam bahasa Inggeris dalam kedua-dua bahasa; penjelasan mengikut bahasa yang anda pilih.

Not counted toward progress.Tidak dikira dalam kemajuan.

stress recovery · post-processingComputing strains and stresses from the solved nodal displacements, {σ} = [E][B]{û}.Mengira strain dan stress daripada nodal displacement yang diselesaikan, {σ} = [E][B]{û}.
strain–displacement matrix [B][∂]ᵀ[N], 3 × 8 for a four-node element: its rows give εxx, εyy, εxy from the eight nodal displacements.[∂]ᵀ[N], 3 × 8 bagi four-node element: barisnya memberi εxx, εyy, εxy daripada lapan nodal displacement.
primary · derived resultDisplacements are solved for; strains and stresses are derived by differentiation and are less accurate.Displacement diselesaikan secara langsung; strain dan stress diterbitkan melalui pembezaan dan kurang tepat.
principal stresses σ1, σ2The normal stresses on the planes where the shear is zero; the largest and smallest normal stress at the point.Normal stress pada satah di mana shear sifar; normal stress terbesar dan terkecil pada titik itu.
principal direction θpAngle from the x-axis to σ1: ½ tan−1[2σxy/(σxx − σyy)], taken in the right quadrant.Sudut dari paksi x ke σ1: ½ tan−1[2σxy/(σxx − σyy)], diambil dalam sukuan yang betul.
Mohr’s circleThe stress state drawn as a circle: centre (σxx + σyy)/2, radius √[((σxx − σyy)/2)² + σxy²].Keadaan stress dilukis sebagai bulatan: pusat (σxx + σyy)/2, jejari √[((σxx − σyy)/2)² + σxy²].
von Mises stressAn equivalent uniaxial stress for yielding of ductile metals: √(σ1² − σ1σ2 + σ2²) in plane stress.Stress uniaxial setara untuk alah logam mulur: √(σ1² − σ1σ2 + σ2²) dalam plane stress.
Elemental meanDisplay option: one value per element, at its centroid.Pilihan paparan: satu nilai setiap element, pada centroid-nya.
UnaveragedDisplay option: each element’s own nodal values; the jumps between elements stay visible.Pilihan paparan: nilai node setiap element sendiri; lompatan antara element kekal kelihatan.
Averaged · nodal averagingDisplay option: the mean of all elements at a node; smooth, but no more accurate.Pilihan paparan: purata semua element pada satu node; licin, tetapi tidak lebih tepat.
stress jumpThe difference between neighbouring elements’ stresses at a shared side; a free indicator of the local mesh error.Perbezaan stress element berjiran pada sisi yang dikongsi; penunjuk percuma bagi ralat mesh setempat.
St-Venant’s principleHow a load is applied matters only within about one depth of where it acts; beyond that only its resultant counts.Cara load dikenakan hanya penting dalam kira-kira satu kedalaman dari tempat ia bertindak; selepas itu hanya resultant-nya yang dikira.
singularityA point where the elastic stress is infinite (fully fixed re-entrant corner, point load): the computed peak grows with every refinement.Titik di mana stress elastic infiniti (re-entrant corner tetap sepenuhnya, point load): puncak yang dikira meningkat dengan setiap refine.
stress concentration · KtA finite local rise of stress at a smooth hole or fillet; Kt = peak/nominal; it converges under refinement.Kenaikan stress setempat yang terhingga pada lubang licin atau fillet; Kt = puncak/nominal; ia converge apabila di-refine.
8-node (serendipity) element · Q8Rectangle with corner and mid-side nodes, 16 dofs, quadratic along every side; PLANE183 in ANSYS.Segi empat tepat dengan node bucu dan tengah sisi, 16 dof, quadratic di sepanjang setiap sisi; PLANE183 dalam ANSYS.
consistent edge loadsNodal shares of an edge load from ∫Niq ds: ½, ½ on a 4-node side; ⅙, ⅔, ⅙ on an 8-node side.Bahagian nodal bagi edge load daripada ∫Niq ds: ½, ½ pada sisi 4-node; ⅙, ⅔, ⅙ pada sisi 8-node.
shear locking · parasitic shearA 4-node element bent by a moment shears because its sides stay straight; the spurious shear energy makes it too stiff.4-node element yang dilentur oleh momen mengalami shear kerana sisinya kekal lurus; tenaga shear palsu menjadikannya terlalu kaku.
rate of convergence pThe error falls as hp; halving h divides it by 2p. About 2 for Q4 displacements of smooth problems, lower at a clamped corner.Ralat menurun sebagai hp; membahagi dua h membahagikannya dengan 2p. Kira-kira 2 bagi displacement Q4 masalah licin, lebih rendah pada bucu terkapit.
Richardson extrapolationAn estimate of the converged value from two or three meshes: Q ≈ Qh/2 + (Qh/2 − Qh)/(2p − 1).Anggaran nilai converge daripada dua atau tiga mesh: Q ≈ Qh/2 + (Qh/2 − Qh)/(2p − 1).
convergence tableThree or more meshes, the quantity of interest on each, and the change between the last two in per cent.Tiga atau lebih mesh, kuantiti yang dikehendaki pada setiap satu, dan perubahan antara dua yang terakhir dalam peratus.
independent checkA comparison with something not computed by the same model: beam theory, equilibrium of reactions, a textbook Kt, a hand calculation.Perbandingan dengan sesuatu yang tidak dikira oleh model yang sama: beam theory, keseimbangan reaction, Kt buku teks, pengiraan tangan.
idealisationThe modelling decisions: 2D or not, plane stress or plane strain, thickness, material, supports, loads, what is left out.Keputusan pemodelan: 2D atau tidak, plane stress atau plane strain, ketebalan, bahan, support, load, apa yang ditinggalkan.
symmetry modelModelling a half or a quarter of a symmetric structure under a symmetric load, with rollers on the cut edges.Memodelkan separuh atau satu perempat struktur simetri di bawah load simetri, dengan roller pada tepi yang dipotong.

Short notesNota ringkas

§1 Stress recoveryStress recovery

Use local x, y of the element that contains the point. Cantilever (3.5, 1.3): σ = {315.2, −44.9, −310.9} kN m−2. Keep 5–6 decimals in û.Guna x, y local bagi element yang mengandungi titik itu. Cantilever (3.5, 1.3): σ = {315.2, −44.9, −310.9} kN m−2. Kekalkan 5–6 tempat perpuluhan dalam û.

§2 Principal and von MisesPrincipal dan von Mises

σ1,2 = c ± R; θp = ½ tan−1[2σxy/(σxx − σyy)]; σvM = √(σ1² − σ1σ2 + σ2²). Cantilever: 494.4, −224.1, −30.0°, 636.8.σ1,2 = c ± R; θp = ½ tan−1[2σxy/(σxx − σyy)]; σvM = √(σ1² − σ1σ2 + σ2²). Cantilever: 494.4, −224.1, −30.0°, 636.8.

§3 AccuracyKetepatan

  • Read stresses at centroids, on converged meshes, away from supports and point loads.Baca stress pada centroid, pada mesh yang converge, jauh dari support dan point load.
  • Beam check M(y − H/2)/I only away from the ends: (3.5, 1.3) converged 153 vs beam 225.Semakan beam M(y − H/2)/I hanya jauh dari hujung: (3.5, 1.3) converge 153 berbanding beam 225.

§4 Display options and singularitiesPilihan paparan dan singularity

Elemental mean · Unaveraged (jumps) · Averaged (smooth). Fixed corner 4134 → 7467 kN m−2: singular, never report. Hole: Kt 2.34, converges.Elemental mean · Unaveraged (lompatan) · Averaged (licin). Bucu tetap 4134 → 7467 kN m−2: singular, jangan laporkan. Lubang: Kt 2.34, converge.
